description: Canaux appartenant à la MEL is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille . This data makes it possible to visualize only the canals (i.e. the state-owned watercourses managed by a public manager) belonging to the European Metropolis of Lille. More specifically, it is the Marque urbaine/Canal de Roubaix system, from the Marcq lock to the Belgian border. Coverage: Métropole Européenne de Lille . The portal shows the English title as "Channels belonging to the MEL" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Européenne de Lille . Its keywords include reseau-hydrographique, patrimoine, metropole-europeenne-de-lille, inspire, assainissement-eau-hydrographie, canal. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
